evals.name: add-withdrawals-chart
evals.prompt: add withdrawals by day to the business overview page, same format as the deposit chart
evals.expected_output: Reads the ftd-report/cache month files rather than calling Redash; checks that `withdraw` shares a row with `blockchain` before splitting it by rail; carves out karolik777 by default; follows the house chart conventions (zero labelled, sign before currency symbol); tests the built page in jsdom.

evals.name: new-bonus-cost-page
evals.prompt: make me a new standalone html page showing bonus cost by day broken down by bonus group, for august
evals.expected_output: Uses the three-file build pattern (builder .py -> data .json -> template + maker -> standalone html at the folder root); discovers that bonus_group and game_product almost never share a row; excludes the whale by default; produces a page that actually renders.

evals.name: diagnose-suspect-figure
evals.prompt: our june GGR looks way off compared to may, can you check what's going on
evals.expected_output: Investigates from the cache rows; identifies karolik777 as the driver (his GGR swings +$7.27M in May to -$3.43M in June); distinguishes raw GGR from adjusted GGR; reports the ex-whale figures alongside the headline ones rather than just restating the anomaly.
